relationships.relationship: The photograph does not provide blank space; it provides dark or lower-frequency pockets. Small top claims and footer text sit in the quietest pockets, while the dominant title uses greater light mass to tolerate a more textured central field.
relationships.source_region: top claim pockets, central title backing field, bottom footer field
relationships.causal_hypothesis: Local frequency and luminance are matched to text scale and weight, preventing one global overlay treatment.
relationships.counterfactual: Small text placed over the sharp right foliage or bright patches would lose hierarchy and legibility.
relationships.validation_requirement: Measure local contrast/frequency after CONTENT_SWAP and ASPECT_ADAPT.

relationships.relationship: A broad, high-authority title mass counterbalances an edge-to-edge complex environmental photograph. The title is large enough to behave as an object, while the photograph remains active around and through it rather than becoming a passive backdrop.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: The display mass needs sufficient area and irregular silhouette to remain distinct from high-frequency organic detail.
relationships.counterfactual: A small conventional wordmark would be swallowed by foliage; a near-full-frame title would erase environmental depth.
relationships.validation_requirement: Vary title scale and photo complexity in a controlled composition test.

relationships.relationship: Soft foreground and receding background frame a sharper middle information plane. Text remains visually on the designed surface while the photographic layers continue to read behind it, producing depth without cutting the image into panels.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: Depth staging gives the page an authored environmental world and lets information occupy a coherent middle plane.
relationships.counterfactual: Uniform sharpness would make all foliage compete equally with text; a flat image would remove spatial framing.

relationships.relationship: Photographic highlights are controlled below the brightest type; broad dark regions around top and bottom information protect small copy. Light variation supplies texture but does not steal the highlight ceiling from the identity system.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: A bounded photographic luminance range lets typographic roles remain legible without artificial panels or heavy shadows.
relationships.counterfactual: Specular or sunlit hotspots behind every text tier would destroy the reading order.
relationships.validation_requirement: LIGHTING_REBIND or CONTENT_SWAP under a different natural light field.

relationships.relationship: The environmental field owns most chromatic area; light text owns authority; a small warm role links badge, path and handwritten voice; quieter beige text bridges those extremes. The warm role is limited and relational, not a page-wide grade.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: Repeated limited accent color can bind separate semantic voices while preserving the photographic field as dominant.
relationships.counterfactual: Expanding the accent across large areas or using it as an arbitrary underline would turn semantic continuity into decoration.
relationships.validation_requirement: PALETTE_SHIFT and accent-omission comparison; later human evidence requires treating the path as optional.

relationships.relationship: The mountain-like title construction has a visible semantic relationship to the literal 山 character and environmental setting. The accent path visually connects identity roles, but its specific narrative meaning is not proven.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: Subject-derived form can make the display object feel authored rather than generically decorated.
relationships.counterfactual: Importing mountain shapes, seals or scribbles when the new subject does not support them would become literal surface copying.
relationships.validation_requirement: MOTIF_REBIND using a new subject-derived structural metaphor.

relationships.relationship: The photograph remains continuous and unmasked across nearly the whole frame. Graphics occupy limited areas, retain clean edges, and do not repaint foliage or impose a synthetic texture over it. Selective focus and natural edge variation remain visible beneath the design.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: Restrained graphic intervention allows the environmental field to remain credible rather than reading as AI-poster texture.
relationships.counterfactual: Global distress, excessive glow, full-frame color effects or over-sharpening would collapse realism.
relationships.validation_requirement: Detail-scale review in every future generated output.

relationships.relationship: Graphic density and photographic density are regionally coordinated rather than uniformly low: small text uses quiet photo zones; the central graphic mass can cross denser foliage because its scale and contrast increase; the lower photographic field is left mostly free before the footer closes the page.
relationships.causal_hypothesis: The system avoids simultaneous high texture and high information density everywhere.
relationships.counterfactual: Adding equal amounts of copy and motifs across all foliage regions would create undifferentiated promotional clutter.
relationships.validation_requirement: DENSITY_SHIFT with explicit local density map and human thumbnail review.
